chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:

The earth has not cried out to its Lord, Mighty and Majestic, as it cries out because of three things: unlawful blood that is shed upon it, bathing from zina, and sleeping upon it before the rising of the sun.

key_terms.دَمٍ حَرَامٍ: unlawful blood; bloodshed that is forbidden and sinful
key_terms.طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ: the rising of the sun, meaning sunrise
key_terms.يُسْفَكُ: is shed or spilled, especially of blood

ai.seo_question: What deeds cause the earth to cry out to Allah according to this hadith?
ai.summary: Imam عليه السلام describes three acts that weigh heavily upon the earth: the shedding of unlawful blood, the aftermath of zina, and sleeping past sunrise. The hadith conveys the moral gravity of sin and impurity, portraying the earth itself as recoiling from such deeds before Allah, the Mighty and Majestic.
